items.title: handleCacheHeaders returns 304 for matching If-None-Match on POST and PUT
items.body:
### Environment

h3 2.0.8, Node.js 24.16.0. Also reproduced on main at f0e17808ac2439b6434bb10609a961067f4d555b.

### Reproduction

Run in an empty directory:

```sh
npm init -y
npm install h3@2.0.8
node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import { H3Event, handleCacheHeaders } from "h3";

for (const method of ["GET", "HEAD", "QUERY", "POST", "PUT"]) {
  const event = new H3Event(new Request("https://example.com/resource", {
    method,
    headers: { "if-none-match": '"v1"' },
  }));
  const stop = handleCacheHeaders(event, { etag: '"v1"' });
  console.log(method, stop, event.res.status);
}
EOF
```

### Describe the bug

Every request above returns `true` and sets status `304`. For POST and PUT, the expected status is `412 Precondition Failed`.

[RFC 9110 §13.1.2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-13.1.2) requires an evaluated, matching `If-None-Match` to stop POST and PUT with `412`. Returning `false` and continuing these writes would also violate that precondition. The helper already tells callers to stop when it returns `true`, so retaining that return value and selecting `412` preserves its control-flow contract. This does not apply to OPTIONS, TRACE, or CONNECT: [§13.2.1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-13.2.1) requires ignoring conditional headers for those methods.

Separately, POST with only a matching `If-Modified-Since` should continue normally, as required by [§13.1.3](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-13.1.3), rather than returning `304` or `412`.

A focused fix and regression tests are prepared.

### Additional context

H3 explicitly supports conditional QUERY requests. Its documented `304` behavior should remain unchanged, consistent with [RFC 10008 §2.6 and Appendix A.5](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc10008#section-2.6). GET and HEAD also keep their existing behavior. `serveStatic` and the ocache-backed route rule already gate their cache handling to GET/HEAD.

### Logs

```text
GET true 304
HEAD true 304
QUERY true 304
POST true 304
PUT true 304
```
